seed: Objects of type `target` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: no_change x40, born x2. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 steps 5 cells per A1-A4; dest box with any colour-4/5 cell or off-board is blocked (still burns 2 bar cells).
A full 5-cell colour-1 strip just outside a dest edge is a conveyor: player slides away from it until blocked.
Every action turns the two leftmost 11 bar cells to 3; a fully covered refuel ring is consumed and refills the bar.
Covering the 'collect' diamond rotates the HUD glyph 90 CW; the target 'born' x2 cases are the diamond reappearing once the player uncovers it (under-player underlay, continuity-gated).
Unconfirmed: recolor token and legend-chamber unlock rule (not exercised in these 40 transitions).
